articles.summary: BEIJING, June 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Julong Holding Limited (“Julong” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: JLHL), a growth-oriented provider of intelligent integrated solutions, today announced changes to the composition of its board of directors (the “Board”) and board committees.
